Title: Water Balloon Challenge
Content: To win the water balloon challenge, students need to maximize the mass of the water balloon and avoid having it burst before it can be catapulted.

Students fill `7` identical water balloons with water until they reach masses between `0.9`0 and `text(0.94 kilograms)`. They observe the water balloons to see if they immediately burst and record the data.
A student claims that the maximum mass for the water balloon should be `text(0.91 kg)`. Another student is concerned that there may be a measurement error.
